Title: Lily + Claude Code — Lily Design System

Description: 30 Claude Skills give Claude Code curated, loadable entry point enter Lily Design System — general concepts, per-framework umbrellas, and per-subproject deep dives for di headless library and di *-picker helpers.

# Skills for AI agents make Lily even easier

Lily dey ship focused skills — general, per-framework, and per-subproject — so agent go load exactly di context wey e need and nothing wey e no need.

## Which skill you want?

Each tier answer different question. Load di general skill when you no know Lily yet. Load framework skill when you know your framework but you no know which subproject you need. Load headless-skill or helpers-skill directly when you already know exactly wetin you dey work on.

- **General / maintainer** — “Wetin be Lily?” / “How dem put dis monorepo together?” — [`lily-design-system-skill`](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system/tree/main/lily-design-system-skill), [`lily-design-system-maintainer-skill`](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system/tree/main/lily-design-system-maintainer-skill)
- **Framework umbrella** — “Wetin dey available for {framework}, and which piece I need?” — 8, one `{framework}-skill` each
- **Headless / helpers** — “How exactly I go use {framework} components / *-picker helpers?” — 16, one `{framework}-headless-skill` and one `{framework}-helpers-skill` each

## Di eight frameworks

Every framework get di same three-deep stack. Di umbrella skill dey map all di real subprojects of dat framework — including di example app, wey neither of im two sibling skills cover — and e dey point down enter dem instead of to repeat dia contracts.

Web Components na di one exception for both directions: im headless catalog na deliberate 574-of-607 scope (native custom elements, no framework runtime; di other 35 components dem permanently exclude), and no Web Components example app dey yet — im umbrella skill talk so instead of to imply say one dey.

## Add one skill

Each skill na [`SKILL.md`](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) file — plus supporting files, no build step. Clone di one wey you need enter wherever your Claude Code setup dey load skills from (see di official docs wey dem link above for your project or account skills directory):

```
git clone https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system
cd lily-design-system/lily-design-system-svelte-skill
```

You dey work across several frameworks, or for di monorepo itself? Clone di [canonical monorepo](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system) instead — all 30 skills already dey for im root, beside di headless libraries, di helpers catalogs, and di example apps wey dem describe.
